draft.name: New FAPI Calc
draft.description: Generic worksheet for FAPI lines, EUR/CAD summaries and the actual 2024 EUR P&L reconciliation. Requires reviewed tax inputs; accounting support remains distinct.

metadata.notes: Account mappings describe accounting presentation only; they do not determine FAPI tax treatment. All FAPI tax operands remain blank until reviewed. Zero is accepted only when explicitly supplied. Rebind inputs to reviewed source or rollup fields when appropriate. Existing FAPI formulas are preserved without tax-policy changes. The annual mean EUR/CAD API value is context-specific, not a claim about the legally required conversion method. Original workbook binary must be retained separately. No mock runs or synthetic tax values are included.
